about.title: About us
about.communityBody: Strikers Match is built to connect the international combat sports community: athletes, coaches, gyms, managers, promoters, sponsors, and event professionals.
about.missionBody: We make it easier to find fights, publish events, complete fight cards, and locate the services needed to operate combat sports events in any market.
about.workBody: The platform offers public profiles, directories, registration tools, matchmaking, and event operations. Strikers Match provides technology that facilitates connections; it is not a promoter, organizer, coach, or sanctioning body.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For support or questions about your account, profiles, events, or the directory, contact the Strikers Match team.

pricing.title: Platform tools
pricing.subtitle: Features for creating events, registering athletes, matching fighters, managing bouts, and printing event sheets.
pricing.studioDescription: Production tools for preparing local cameras, graphics, and broadcast operations from the event.
